newsitem.title: USA: Denver cargo up 0.2 pct in Dec, 3.6 pct for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Denver cargo up 0.2 pct in Dec, 3.6 pct for 1996.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Denver International Airport increased by 0.2 percent in December and 3.6 percent for 1996, the airport authority reported.
The two year old airport handled 829 million pounds of cargo last year, an increase of 30.2 million pounds, it said.
United Airlines, which operates a major passenger hub at Denver, accounted for 38.5 percent of all cargo through DIA. United's cargo traffic rose 10.8 percent last year to 331 million pounds.

Largest of all cargo carriers were Federal Express, which handled 20.3 percent of freight traffic, and UPS with 14.4 percent. No other carrier, passenger or all-cargo, accounted for more than 3.9 percent of the airport's freight and mail traffic. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
